identity_sessions_admin_mfa_elevation_ck.name: identity_sessions_admin_mfa_elevation_ck
identity_sessions_admin_mfa_elevation_ck.value:
(
        ("identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_at" IS NULL
          AND "identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_until" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_until" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_until" > "identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_at"
          AND "identity_sessions"."admin_mfa_elevated_until" <= "identity_sessions"."absolute_expires_at")
      )

identity_admin_audit_events_actor_shape_.name: identity_admin_audit_events_actor_shape_ck
identity_admin_audit_events_actor_shape_.value:
(
        ("identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_type" = 'user'
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_operator_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_type" = 'operator'
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_operator_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_type" = 'system'
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_operator_id" IS NULL)
      )

identity_admin_audit_events_approvers_di.name: identity_admin_audit_events_approvers_distinct_ck
identity_admin_audit_events_approvers_di.value:
"identity_admin_audit_events"."approver_operator_id" IS NULL
        OR "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_operator_id" IS NULL
        OR "identity_admin_audit_events"."approver_operator_id" <> "identity_admin_audit_events"."actor_operator_id"

identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations.name: identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations_issuer_shape_ck
identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations.value:
(
        ("identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."recovery_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."issued_by_operator_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."approved_by_operator_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."issued_by_operator_id" <> "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."approved_by_operator_id")
        OR
        ("identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."recovery_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."issued_by_operator_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_admin_enrollment_authorizations"."approved_by_operator_id" IS NULL)
      )

identity_mfa_factors_state_ck.name: identity_mfa_factors_state_ck
identity_mfa_factors_state_ck.value:
(
        ("identity_mfa_factors"."status" = 'pending'
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."pending_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."pending_session_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."confirmed_at" IS NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_mfa_factors"."status" = 'active'
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."pending_expires_at" IS NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."pending_session_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_mfa_factors"."status" = 'revoked'
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."pending_session_id" IS NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_factors"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approva.name: identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approvals_distinct_ck
identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approva.value:
"identity_mfa_recoveries"."requested_by_operator_id" IS NULL
        OR "identity_mfa_recoveries"."approved_by_operator_id" IS NULL
        OR "identity_mfa_recoveries"."requested_by_operator_id" <> "identity_mfa_recoveries"."approved_by_operator_id"

identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approva.name: identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approval_required_ck
identity_mfa_recoveries_operator_approva.value:
"identity_mfa_recoveries"."method" <> 'operator'
        OR "identity_mfa_recoveries"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'completed')
        OR ("identity_mfa_recoveries"."requested_by_operator_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_recoveries"."approved_by_operator_id" IS NOT NULL)

identity_mfa_recoveries_hold_timestamp_c.name: identity_mfa_recoveries_hold_timestamp_ck
identity_mfa_recoveries_hold_timestamp_c.value:
(
        ("identity_mfa_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "identity_mfa_recoveries"."admin_hold_until" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_mfa_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_mfa_recoveries"."admin_hold_until" = "identity_mfa_recoveries"."completed_at" + interval '24 hours')
      )

seller_onboarding_applications_fields_no.name: seller_onboarding_applications_fields_not_blank_ck
seller_onboarding_applications_fields_no.value:
(
        ("seller_onboarding_applications"."applicant_legal_name" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."applicant_legal_name") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."area_served" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."area_served") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."contact_phone" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."contact_phone") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."seller_display_name" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."seller_display_name") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."registered_business_name" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."registered_business_name") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."business_role" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."business_role") <> '')
        AND ("seller_onboarding_applications"."storefront_name" IS NULL OR btrim("seller_onboarding_applications"."storefront_name") <> '')
      )

seller_onboarding_applications_category_.name: seller_onboarding_applications_category_fields_ck
seller_onboarding_applications_category_.value:
(
        ("seller_onboarding_applications"."category" = 'individual'
          AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."registered_business_name" IS NULL
          AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."business_role" IS NULL
          AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."storefront_name" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("seller_onboarding_applications"."category" = 'commercial'
          AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."seller_display_name" IS NULL)
      )

seller_onboarding_applications_submissio.name: seller_onboarding_applications_submission_timestamp_ck
seller_onboarding_applications_submissio.value:
(
        ("seller_onboarding_applications"."status" = 'draft' AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."first_submitted_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("seller_onboarding_applications"."status" <> 'draft' AND "seller_onboarding_applications"."first_submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )
